description: This file defines a Python class 'WindowsSDKApi' that provides an API for managing Windows SDK installations and environment setup, including ensuring SDK presence and configuring environment variables.

classes.name: WindowsSDKApi
classes.description: API class for managing Windows SDK installation and environment setup via CIPD.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WindowsSDKApi with SDK properties such as package and version.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Context manager that sets up the Windows SDK environment, no-op on non-Windows platforms.

methods.name: _ensure_sdk
methods.description: Ensures the Windows SDK CIPD package is installed and returns the SDK directory path.

methods.name: _sdk_env
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for the SDK based on JSON configuration.
